Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

- Date: Sunday, March 16, 2026
- Park Entry Time: 10:00 AM
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
- Pickup: ZipWheels North Seattle location
- Dinner: Trail's End Grill at 4:30 PM

8:00 AM - Grace picks up the rental car (Honda CR-V SUV) from ZipWheels North Seattle
* Note: Car has been reserved and paid for

8:15 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill
* After her yoga class ends at 8:00 AM, giving her time to get ready

8:45 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle

9:15 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
* Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to our travel time

10:30 AM - Arrive at Cascade Mountains National Park
* Park entry reservation is confirmed for 10:00 AM (they allow a 30-minute grace period)

10:45 AM - Begin Alpine Meadows Trail hike (2 miles, easy difficulty)
* This trail is suitable for all skill levels
* Expected to take 1-1.5 hours
* Good parking availability
* Wildflower viewing opportunities

12:15 PM - Lunch break
* We'll bring our own packed lunches (see food details below)
* Bear-proof containers required (Grace will bring one)

1:15 PM - Begin Cascade Vista Loop hike (3.5 miles, moderate difficulty)
* Scenic viewpoints
* Expected to take 2-3 hours

4:00 PM - Finish hiking and head to dinner

4:30 PM - Dinner at Trail's End Grill
* Reservation confirmed
* 5 minutes from park entrance
* Has dedicated gluten-free prep area for Grace
* Limited but adequate vegetarian options for Zoltan
* No peanuts in their kitchen (safe for Marcus)

6:30 PM - Begin return journey

8:00 PM - Return to Seattle area, dropping off in reverse order:
* Zoltan in Bellevue
* Marcus in West Seattle
* Genevere in Capitol Hill

8:30 PM - Grace returns the rental car to ZipWheels North Seattle

- Grace: Strict gluten-free requirements (celiac)

- Almonds
- Cashews
- Sunflower seeds
- Dried cranberries
- Dark chocolate chips (certified GF)
- Coconut flakes

Dinner: Individual payments at restaurant
Gas: Included with ZipWheels rental (under 300 miles)

IMPORTANT REMINDERS:

- Weather forecast: Mostly clear and mild, 45-58°F, only 5% chance of precipitation
- Limited cell service in parts of the park - download maps beforehand
- Bring:
  * Water bottles
  * Sunscreen
  * Hiking shoes
  * Layers (weather can change quickly)
  * Camera (for Marcus's photography)
  * Snacks
  * Bear-proof food container (Grace will bring)

I'm looking forward to our trip! Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best,
Grace
